name: ChatGPT for Sales
desc: A Sales plugin that works your CRM from inside ChatGPT.
desc_zh: 在 ChatGPT 里直接操作 CRM 的 Sales 插件。
solves: Pipeline work means switching between the CRM, the inbox and a doc. The plugin pulls account and deal context into the conversation and drafts the follow-up for review.
solves_zh: 做管道推进就得在 CRM、邮箱和文档之间来回切换。这个插件把客户和商机上下文带进对话，并草拟好跟进内容等你过目。
best_for: You are prepping for a call and need the account history without opening the CRM.
best_for_zh: 你在准备一通电话，需要客户历史又不想打开 CRM。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — OpenAI news, https://openai.com/index/introducing-chatgpt-for-sales）。 Reached as a plugin from the plugin directory; workspace admins enable it. Over 30 partner plugins ship with it. 首次公开日期来源：https://openai.com/index/introducing-chatgpt-for-sales
